instruction.text: Goods are transported using different modes of transport. Read the text and select the matching image.
Which one of the following is not a common way to transport goods?
Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: The type of transport used to move goods depends on a number of factors such as distance, time and cost. Planes are often used to transport goods quickly around the world.
Boats are used to transport large quantities of goods more cheaply over long distances.
Lorries and trains transport goods over shorter distances inside their own country or to nearby countries.

atoms.a: Which mode of transport is best for transporting goods quickly?
Which mode of transport is best for transporting large quantities of goods?
Which two modes of transport are best for transporting goods over shorter distances?

instruction.text: Select the three factors that are important to consider when transporting goods.
Draw a line between the two points on the map.

feedback.end: This is the Panama Canal, which flows between North and South America.

atoms.b: The Panama Canal is a man-made waterway cutting through the country of Panama. It was built to reduce time for ((++boats helicopters)) travelling between the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans.
Without the canal, boats would have to sail all the way around ((++South_America Australia)), which would take weeks and cost a lot more money!

instruction.text: Ports are very important places for global trade. Drag the boat to the dock to learn more.

finish.text: A port is a place where ships stop to load and unload goods. Without them, it would be a lot more expensive and difficult to transport goods.

instruction.text: Are these vehicles commonly used to transport goods? Drag each one to the correct category.
